title: Serialize FileKeyStore writers and handle generation exhaustion
description: SECURITY/ROBUSTNESS: FileKeyStore.store_seed reads both slot generations and then writes a predictable per-slot .tmp without any inter-process lock/CAS. Concurrent rotations can select the same slot/generation, race the same temp path, lose an acknowledged seed update, or raise after another writer renames it. At generation 0xffffffff, max+1 also fails struct.pack rather than entering an explicit safe terminal state. Add process-safe serialization/unique temp handling, define u32 generation exhaustion/rollback semantics, and stress concurrent/crash boundary tests.
